Approved by the user as its own ticket on the fz-mue.32 page (/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.32.html), relayed by Elixir Parity 2026-11-20. Owner: Elixir Parity.

When clauses of one name and arity are separated by another definition, Elixir warns: clauses with the same name and arity (number of arguments) should be grouped together, "def h/1" was previously defined (m.ex:16). fz emits the same warning from the definition walk through the existing emit_warning_once path. Done when an oracle fixture shows the warning text on all three paths.
title: Clauses of one name and arity that are not adjacent warn "should be grouped together", as in Elixir
